limitations: DLC Zoo output is eight keypoints plus fitted ellipse geometry; no prediction mask exists.
NeuroPupil output is four keypoints and direct paper diameter geometry; no prediction mask exists.
GT pupil-only PNGs are exact pixel-class extractions from the frozen primary GT raster, not model predictions.
Selected cases are a bounded manual panel; population-level identity checks are automated and do not imply manual review of all 252 frames.
This manifest does not alter canonical scientific results, gates, or the canonical FINAL_VISUAL_QC_STATUS.csv.

outcomeSelection.NeuroPupilAbstention: maximum finite keypoint count, then highest minimum score among present keypoints, then row-index tie-break; a high-confidence incomplete prediction, not an error metric
outcomeSelection.ZooAbstention: maximum retained native point count among rejected rows; row-index tie-break
outcomeSelection.worstValid: maximum accepted diameter_are, computed per method over the 252 frozen spatial rows

selectionProtocol.scope: selected-case visual QC and static exact-GT media only; not representative accuracy claims
